groups.description: Test catalogue validation and safe selection failures.

groups.description: Persistence runner console transport: EOF, timeouts, rejected upgrades and resource release.
groups.requires: Python 3 standard library; no database, engine or Docker daemon.

groups.description: GeoIP input parsing, overlaps, gzip integrity and country mapping.
groups.requires: Python 3 standard library; no provider download or database driver.
groups.effects: Temporary compressed inputs and SQLite files.

groups.description: Demo toolbar source wiring, command tokens, controls and layout assertions.
groups.requires: Tracked GSC and client menu sources.
groups.effects: Read-only source checks; does not build or render a menu.

groups.description: Notification glow texture and material consistency.
groups.requires: Tracked client IWI textures and materials; Python standard library.
groups.effects: Read-only asset checks; no game or rendering.

groups.description: Empty database bootstrap, repeat preservation, runtime rights and new/existing backup restore.
groups.requires: Docker and mysql:8.0 image; resources for a separate database.
groups.effects: Creates then removes a network-isolated container and credentials; keeps private evidence.

groups.description: External volume survives Compose teardown.
groups.requires: Initialized disposable Compose installation and running db; Docker/mysql:8.0.
groups.effects: Inspects selected mount; creates/removes only a separate probe volume and project.

groups.description: GeoIP import, publication and lookup against synthetic data.
groups.requires: Selected disposable Compose database and locally built GeoIP updater image.
groups.effects: Creates/removes temporary schema, account and password file; helper runs inside updater image.

groups.description: Exact-category notification SQL cases.
groups.requires: Selected disposable Compose database with current schema.
groups.effects: Connection-local read-only CTE fixtures using the runtime account.

groups.description: Snapshot delta and packet acknowledgement recovery.
groups.requires: Initialized CoD4 submodule; Docker Compose build image and compiler.
groups.effects: Temporary build containers and local binaries; no network traffic or game server.

groups.description: Checkpoint corners, elevators, list, replacement and reset fixtures.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching built engine, licensed game/compiled mod and selected maps.
groups.effects: Starts isolated fixture servers and writes private logs; no live players or database.

groups.description: Checkpoint migration matching without a database.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching current engine and licensed game/compiled mod.
groups.effects: Isolated fixture server and private logs.

groups.description: Brush/moving support, checkpoint alternatives, height and insertion.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine, compiled mod and map assets; variants select different fixtures.
groups.effects: Isolated fixture servers and private logs.

groups.description: Aim teleport, measurement, moon boost and FPS history.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine, game/compiled mod and relevant maps; FPS history compiles a plugin. Aim-teleport coordinates require mp_dark.
groups.effects: Isolated fixture servers, synthetic players and private logs; no gameplay database.

groups.description: Tutorial mode: auto-FPS choices and shot timing on synthetic player states, checkpoint landing targets, tutorial save flag and auto-FPS script API.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, an engine built with server-ext/opencj_autofps.cpp, licensed game/compiled mod and mp_killhouse.
groups.effects: Isolated servers, a compiled test plugin and a test client; private logs, no gameplay database. Does not prove a real client applies com_maxfps.
commands: python3 -B dev-tools/tests/run-demo-viewing-24.py mp_killhouse --fixture dev-tools/tests/tutorial-mode.gsc --completion-marker "TUTORIAL MODE COMPLETE"

groups.description: Blue2 and Descent finish handlers.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine/compiled mod and the named map assets.
groups.effects: Isolated fixture servers; no human clients or database writes.

groups.description: Command menu, download cvars, finish aliases, FPS registration, connecting scoreboard and specular settings.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine and licensed game/compiled assets; specular checks also use mp_crash.
groups.effects: Isolated servers, mocked client IO and private evidence. Does not verify a human client's rendering.

groups.description: Demo lifecycle, viewing and timeline scenarios through one isolated GSC runner; selection SQL replay.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine and game/compiled assets (mp_killhouse by default). Selection SQL replay also requires a selected disposable current database and captured fixture log.
groups.effects: Isolated servers and private logs; selection replay uses temporary SQL tables.

groups.description: Country/flag behavior through an isolated engine.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine and explicit compiled assets; --scripts can select the prepared release.
groups.effects: Isolated server and private output; no live restart.

groups.description: Player allocation and save-history memory behavior.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, compiler/build image, matching engine and licensed game/compiled assets. The history runner accepts --engine PATH for a candidate inside the checkout.
groups.effects: Isolated synthetic players and test plugins; no gameplay database.

groups.description: Notification HUD, preferences and record announcements.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, compiler/build image, matching engine and licensed game/compiled assets.
groups.effects: Isolated synthetic players and HUD plugin; private logs.

groups.description: Preferred names and regular-name policy.
groups.requires: Selected disposable current database, matching engine and game/compiled assets.
groups.effects: Disposable database/engine fixture and synthetic names; private evidence.

groups.description: SQL capacity, real GSC query growth and before/current query equivalence.
groups.requires: Selected disposable current database, Docker build/server images, matching engine/assets, two available CPU cores and substantial time. Use documented CPU/fixture options.
groups.effects: Separate synthetic growth databases, engine clients and private measurements; helper scripts need the runner's temporary container/schema.

groups.description: Native sticky-wall parity and recovery against map geometry.
groups.requires: Existing CoD4 build objects, compiler/assembler, Compose engine and mp_galaxy assets; see docs/development/sticky-walls.md.
groups.effects: Builds an instrumented local engine and starts isolated fixture servers; private logs.

groups.description: Current compiled command, startup and route menus.
groups.requires: Explicit current Unlinker output; no historical build required.
groups.effects: Reads extracted assets; optional private JSON evidence. Does not verify rendering.

groups.description: Camera settings, body animation and visibility using the current engine.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose build image, matching current engine and licensed game/compiled mod. Builds the probe from tracked source unless --plugin is supplied.
groups.effects: Isolated server; replay uses temporary SQL tables; private output.

groups.description: Concurrent clip-view receipts, exclusions and cleanup on the current schema.
groups.requires: Docker/mysql:8.0 and resources for a separate database; no existing database.
groups.effects: Bootstraps a network-isolated database with synthetic clips; removes container and credentials.

groups.description: Current challenge-route binding, shop transactions and finish ranking.
groups.requires: Selected disposable current-schema Compose database; administrative fixture access for route/shop setup.
groups.effects: Route rows roll back; shop synthetic rows are removed; finish ranking uses read-only CTEs.

groups.description: Save ownership, native demo/clip transfers, pool and VM behavior; publication races, rollback, lost replies and receipt recovery. Shop reads stop after close or browser replacement and do not publish late results.
groups.requires: Selected disposable current database, Compose compiler image, current engine and game/compiled mod. Optional --engine PATH selects a candidate inside the core checkout.
groups.effects: Creates/removes a temporary schema, grants and engine; private output.

groups.description: Replay an operator-selected demo and inspect FPS history.
groups.requires: Matching engine/assets and a reviewed recording export, or selected disposable database with synthetic run/clip IDs.
groups.effects: Reads recordings and writes private traces; recorded player data must stay private.

groups.description: Real Discord listener message delivery on a private temporary socket.
groups.requires: Linux/Python standard library; no Discord account or running bridge.
groups.effects: Temporary Unix socket; listener/client tasks and sockets are closed.

groups.description: Compose prerequisite resolution shared by integration runners.
groups.requires: Imported by a runner after its installation is selected.
groups.effects: Resolves the selected installation; not a standalone test.
